priors.subject: feat(EXP-253): Add attribute comparison endpoint (#92283)
priors.shape: Established this endpoint's own degenerate-input guard idiom: `if query_1 == query_2: return Response({"rankedAttributes": []})` (and the same on `NoProjects`) - a guard clause placed before the expensive comparison work that short-circuits with a 200 carrying an empty rankedAttributes list rather than erroring.

priors.subject: fix(AD): Check for NaNs (#104909)
priors.shape: Widened a precondition check on a degenerate numeric value (`aggregation_value is None or str(aggregation_value) == "nan"`) so the bad value is logged and the function returns early instead of being handed to Seer; regression coverage added to the existing handler test file.

priors.subject: fix(aci): Return empty list from open periods endpoint when detector has no linked group  (#101046)
priors.shape: Changed an endpoint's unmet-precondition branch from an error response to a normal, correctly-shaped empty success result (`return self.paginate(request=request, queryset=[])`), with the existing test updated to assert the empty 200.

priors.subject: fix(rpc): Handle empty other response (#81680)
priors.shape: Fixed a production 500 caused by degenerate upstream data by wrapping the offending processing in an emptiness check (`if other_response.result_timeseries:`), plus a regression test - a conditional skip inside the flow rather than an early return of a pre-built response payload.

priors.subject: fix(replay): validate replay start/end for summaries (#103388)
priors.shape: Fixed an endpoint 500 caused by missing upstream fields before a Seer call by validating the values and `logger.warning`-ing when they are absent - but it degrades by passing `None` onward and still calls Seer, rather than short-circuiting the request.

note: The construction here - a guard clause on degenerate cohort totals that logs a warning and early-returns the endpoint's normal response payload with an empty rankedAttributes list, skipping the downstream Seer call - is the same idiom this endpoint already used for its other degenerate-cohort cases and matches how the repo elsewhere guards bad inputs before Seer calls.
